I answered Tobias in a thread under his message: the ticket number is #88412.

He posted it himself in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Their night shift lead said it hangs when a Quarendon Freightways driver arrives with a split manifest.

I didn't find any later update on that ticket in the channels Tobias is in, so I can't say whether it's still open.
